title: Simon 2.6: compactness theorem for BV_loc (frozen BVCompactness)
statement: (Simon Ch. 2, Theorem 2.6, frozen contract BVCompactness.) For every n, every U ⊆ ℝⁿ and every sequence u_k (k ∈ ℕ) with each u_k locally BV on U (SimonGMT IsLocallyBV U (u k)) such that for every open W ⊂⊂ U (IsRelativelyCompactIn W U: closure W compact and ⊆ U) the quantity sup_k ∫⁻_W (‖u_k(x)‖ₑ + bvVariationOn (u k) W) dx is finite (the x-independent constant |Du_k|(W) = bvVariationOn (u k) W sits inside the integrand), there are a strictly increasing ψ : ℕ → ℕ and v : ℝⁿ → ℝ such that v is locally BV on U, u_{ψ(k)} → v in L¹_loc(U) (TendstoLocallyInL1On), and bvVariationOn v W ≤ liminf_k bvVariationOn (u (ψ k)) W for every open W ⊂⊂ U.
